designation: Old and Valuable Tree (OVT, government criteria: DBH >= 1.0m, OR height >= 25m, OR crown spread >= 25m, OR rarity, OR estimated age > 100 years, OR outstanding cultural/historical/social value) and Stonewall Tree (SWT, Ficus growing out of historic masonry retaining walls, a Hong Kong-specific designation). Type field records OVT, SWT, or OVT & SWT.
attribution: Development Bureau (Greening, Landscape and Tree Management Section), DATA.GOV.HK
scope: Complete current register, 713 trees territory-wide (Hong Kong Island, Kowloon, New Territories and outlying areas). This is the semantic-filtered OVT/SWT list, not a street-tree inventory.
caveat: Four things a run must know before using this. (1) dbh_mm is MILLIMETRES: sanity-checked against the register own registration criterion (DBH >= 1.0m qualifies a tree), and the dataset median sits at 1006mm, clustered exactly at that 1.0m threshold, which only makes sense if the unit is mm. Values range from 110mm (11cm, presumably qualifying on height, crown spread, rarity or cultural value rather than girth) to 7710mm on a Ficus microcarpa (a banyan aerial-root/buttress mass, not a simple round trunk). (2) There is no explicit alive/dead or status field. condition_notes is a pipe-separated bag of inspection observations (vigor, lean, wind exposure, pruning history, risk rating); 15 of 713 entries mention "Dead branches" specifically, which is a partial-dieback observation, not a whole-tree-dead flag, and none of the 713 current entries describe the tree itself as dead or felled. That is expected, not reassuring: the department is known to REMOVE a tree from this register once it is felled or fails, so a tree that stood here in an earlier snapshot and is missing now may simply have been dropped rather than still standing; the presence of an OVT number here is not itself proof of life today, only last_inspection_date is. (3) last_inspection_date clusters heavily in 2022 to 2023 (700 of 713), so vitality evidence is recent but still an inspection date, never a same-day fact; treat it as supporting evidence per BRIEF_RESEARCH.md rules, never as the vitality field itself, because none exists. (4) No age field: age must come from other sources (news, AFCD leaflets, monumentaltrees.com as a cross-check) for any tree pulled from this register, same as Portugal ICNF.
